exposure: not being the initiator of sex during partnered sexual activity
cohort: The study participants were Australian women who had given birth during the past 12 months.
finding: Symptoms of postnatal depression are prevalent among Australian women in the first year after childbirth and are significantly associated with sexual dysfunction and relationship dissatisfaction, as well as low educational level, exclusive breastfeeding, clinically diagnosed depression, and not being the initiator of sex.
cross-section timing: within the first year after giving birth
